stories.headline: Iran Offers to Reopen Strait of Hormuz if US Lifts Blockade; Trump Rejects Proposal

key_facts.fact: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for the US lifting its blockade and ending the war, while deferring nuclear negotiations for later.
key_facts.excerpt: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has discussed with regional interlocutors a proposal aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz but deferring talks with the US on Tehran's nuclear programme for later

key_facts.fact: Araghchi conducted a 72-hour diplomatic sprint visiting Pakistan (twice), Oman (Muscat), and Russia (meeting Putin in St. Petersburg) to secure broader buy-in for the plan.
key_facts.excerpt: Araghchi on Monday met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in St Petersburg, after visiting Islamabad twice in two days – the two trips sandwiching a meeting in Muscat, Oman

key_facts.fact: Trump told advisers he is not satisfied with Iran's latest ceasefire proposal, according to a US official.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump is unhappy with the latest Iranian proposal on resolving the two-month war, a U.S. official says

key_facts.fact: Trump faces a May 1 deadline under the War Powers Resolution to obtain congressional authorization to continue military operations against Iran, now in their ninth week.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the 1973 War Powers Resolution, Trump faces a May 1 deadline to obtain congressional authorisation to continue military operations against Iran, now in their ninth week

key_facts.fact: Araghchi also spoke by phone with foreign ministers of Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and France over the past three days to brief them on ceasefire developments.
key_facts.excerpt: Araghchi held telephone calls with the foreign ministers of Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and France over the past three days

stories.headline: Bank of Japan Holds Rates at 0.75% in 6-3 Split Vote, Raises Inflation Forecast to 2.8%

key_facts.fact: The BOJ kept its short-term policy rate at 0.75% in a split 6-3 vote, with three board members dissenting in favor of a rate hike to 1.0%.
key_facts.excerpt: The Bank of Japan held its short-term policy rate at 0.75%, but a 6-3 split vote revealed internal disagreement... Three board members voted for a rate hike to 1.0%

key_facts.fact: The BOJ raised its inflation forecast to 2.8% for fiscal year 2026, while downgrading its GDP growth forecast.
key_facts.excerpt: BOJ stands pat in split vote, boosts inflation forecast to 2.8%

key_facts.fact: The 6-3 split marks the most hawkish divide of the Ueda era, boosting chances of a June rate hike.
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of Japan left its key interest rate unchanged in a split vote that boosted the chance of a June hike

key_facts.fact: Middle Eastern conflicts affecting oil prices are adding inflationary pressure to Japan's economy, cited as a key factor in the BOJ's cautious approach.
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of Japan keeps policy rate steady while raising inflation forecast on Iran war worries

key_facts.fact: The yen steadied after the decision, having firmed initially, while the dollar edged higher as central banks remained in focus.
key_facts.excerpt: The Japanese yen steadied on Tuesday, having firmed initially after the Bank of Japan held interest rates steady in a split vote

stories.headline: Google Signs Classified AI Deal With Pentagon as 600+ Employees Protest in Open Letter

key_facts.fact: Google signed a contract allowing the Pentagon to use its AI models for classified work for 'any lawful government purpose,' on the same day 600+ employees sent a protest letter.
key_facts.excerpt: Google has signed a contract giving the U.S. Department of Defense access to its AI models for classified tasks... The signing happened on the same day more than 600 Google employees sent an open letter to CEO Sundar Pichai

key_facts.fact: Many signatories were from Google's DeepMind AI research lab, writing: 'We want to see AI benefit humanity; not to see it being used in inhumane or extremely harmful ways.'
key_facts.excerpt: more than 600 Google employees - many from the company's DeepMind AI research lab - sent an open letter to CEO Sundar Pichai... 'We want to see AI benefit humanity; not to see it being used in inhumane or extremely harmful ways'

key_facts.fact: Legal experts say the contract's safeguards against mass surveillance and autonomous weapons carry no legal weight, since the agreement doesn't give Google the right to control or veto government decisions.
key_facts.excerpt: Legal experts say the contract's safeguards against mass surveillance and autonomous weapons carry no legal weight, since the agreement explicitly doesn't give Google the right to control or veto government operational decisions

key_facts.fact: Unlike OpenAI, which retained full control over its safety stack in its Pentagon deal, Google committed to adjusting its AI safety filters at the government's request.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI retained full control over its 'Safety Stack' in its February deal... Google, by contrast, has committed to helping the government adjust its safety filters upon request

key_facts.fact: This is the loudest Google employees have been opposing the company since the 2018 Project Maven protest, which led Google to not renew its Pentagon drone imagery contract.
key_facts.excerpt: Back in 2018, after thousands of employees protested, Google chose not to renew its Project Maven contract with the Pentagon and pledged never to use AI for weapons or surveillance. Last year, the company quietly dropped those self-imposed restrictions

stories.headline: Ex-DeepMind Lead David Silver Raises Record $1.1B Seed at $5.1B Valuation for AI Startup

key_facts.fact: Ineffable Intelligence, founded by former DeepMind principal scientist David Silver (creator of AlphaGo), raised ~$1.1B in seed funding at a ~$5.1B valuation — one of the largest seed rounds ever.
key_facts.excerpt: Ineffable Intelligence, founded by renowned AI researcher David Silver, secured approximately $1.1 billion in seed funding, one of the largest early-stage financings ever recorded. The round values the company at roughly $5.1 billion

key_facts.fact: The round includes participation from Sequoia, Lightspeed, Nvidia, and Google, with the UK Sovereign AI Fund also investing.
key_facts.excerpt: Ineffable Intelligence closes Europe's largest seed at $5.1B valuation from Sequoia, Lighspeed

key_facts.fact: The London-based company is focused on developing 'superlearners' — AI systems based on reinforcement learning that learn autonomously rather than relying on human-generated data.
key_facts.excerpt: focused on developing advanced AI systems based on reinforcement learning rather than traditional large language models. Silver is pursuing a 'superlearner' approach in which AI systems learn autonomously through experience instead of relying on human-generated data

key_facts.fact: The round marks a milestone for Europe's technology ecosystem and is the largest seed funding round for a European AI startup.
key_facts.excerpt: The record-setting round also marks a milestone for Europe's technology ecosystem, signaling that the region is increasingly capable of attracting and retaining top-tier AI talent and capital

stories.headline: South Korea Surpasses UK to Become World's 8th-Largest Stock Market at $4.04 Trillion

key_facts.fact: South Korea's total stock market capitalization jumped 45% this year to $4.04 trillion, surpassing the UK's $3.99 trillion to become the world's 8th-largest market.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg reported that Korea's total market capitalization jumped 45 percent this year to $4.04 trillion. This surpassed the U.K.'s $3.99 trillion, which rose 3 percent over the same period

key_facts.fact: The KOSPI broke the 6,700 threshold for the first time on an intraday basis, closing at 6,641.02, up 0.39% from the previous session.
key_facts.excerpt: The index opened 31.77 points, or 0.48 percent, higher at 6,646.80 and maintained its upward momentum, breaking the 6,700 threshold for the first time on an intraday basis

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix account for more than 40% of KOSPI's total market capitalization, driving the AI-linked chip rally.
key_facts.excerpt: Together, the two tech giants now account for more than 40 percent of KOSPI's total market capitalization

key_facts.fact: The UK market was about twice the size of Korea's as recently as 2024, but the gap reversed in just over a year.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.K. market was about twice the size of Korea's as recently as 2024, but the gap has reversed in just over a year

key_facts.fact: Analysts forecast KOSPI could reach 7,100-7,900 based on forward PE normalization, with corporate governance reforms under President Lee Jae Myung providing additional support.
key_facts.excerpt: 'A forward price-to-earnings ratio of 8 times would put KOSPI near 7,100, while 9 times would imply around 7,900'

stories.headline: AI Photonics Chipmaker Lightelligence Surges 408% in Hong Kong IPO Debut

key_facts.fact: Shanghai-based Lightelligence shares surged as much as 408% to HK$930 after pricing at HK$183.20 in its Hong Kong IPO debut.
key_facts.excerpt: shares surging as much as 408% to HK$930 after pricing at HK$183.20 in Hong Kong

key_facts.fact: The company raised about HK$2.5 billion (~$310M) in the IPO, making it one of the most explosive debuts in recent memory.
key_facts.excerpt: The Shanghai-based photonics company raised about HK$2.5 billion and transformed a loss-making startup into one of the city's most eye-catching AI trades of the year

key_facts.fact: The retail tranche was oversubscribed 5,784.7 times, with cornerstone investors including Alibaba Investment, GIC, and Temasek subscribing to more than 71% of the offering.
key_facts.excerpt: the retail tranche was oversubscribed 5,784.7 times, with cornerstone investors including Alibaba Investment, GIC and Temasek subscribing to more than 71% of the offering

key_facts.fact: Lightelligence makes optical interconnect and optical-computing products that use light instead of electronic pathways to move data in AI data centers, reducing latency and power use.
key_facts.excerpt: Lightelligence makes optical interconnect and optical-computing products that use light instead of traditional electronic pathways to move data inside AI systems. The technology helps reduce latency, bandwidth pressure and power use in data centers

key_facts.fact: Frost & Sullivan forecasts the global AI computing and interconnect market will grow at a 27% compound annual rate through 2031.
key_facts.excerpt: Frost & Sullivan, as cited by SCMP, forecasts the global AI computing and interconnect market will grow at a 27% compound annual rate through 2031

stories.headline: ULA Atlas V Launches 29 Amazon Kuiper Satellites, Ties Heaviest Payload Record

key_facts.fact: A United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket launched 29 Amazon Kuiper broadband internet satellites from Cape Canaveral on April 27 at 8:53 PM EDT.
key_facts.excerpt: Liftoff of the mission, dubbed Amazon Leo 6 by United Launch Alliance and Leo Atlas 6 (LA-06) by Amazon Leo, happened at 8:53:30 p.m. EDT (0053:30 UTC)

key_facts.fact: This was ULA's 6th flight delivering production Amazon Kuiper satellites and its 7th overall, with the launch tying the Atlas V record for heaviest payload ever flown.
key_facts.excerpt: Atlas V rocket launches 29 Amazon internet satellites, ties record for heaviest payload it's ever flown

key_facts.fact: ULA completed its second Atlas V launch of the month, marking the company's fastest turnaround at Space Launch Complex 41 to date.
key_facts.excerpt: United Launch Alliance completed its second Atlas V rocket launch of the month, marking the company's fastest turnaround at Space Launch Complex 41 to date. It beats the previous record by nearly three days

key_facts.fact: This was the 108th launch of an Atlas V overall and the 100th under ULA. All 29 satellites were confirmed deployed.
key_facts.excerpt: This was the 108th launch of an Atlas V to date and the 100th under ULA... ULA confirmed deployment of the 29 Amazon Leo satellites

key_facts.fact: SpaceX also attempted a Falcon Heavy launch of the final ViaSat-3 satellite on the same day but scrubbed due to poor weather.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX scrubs Falcon Heavy launch of final ViaSat-3 satellite due to poor weather
